strategies.name: 🩸 Blood
strategies.lede: Buy a hard dip on a coin that is still trading, sell on a bounce.
strategies.formula_text: expected return per trade = P(hit take-profit) × take-profit − P(dies) × loss on death + P(neither) × drift at max hold − round-trip costs
formula_parts: P(hit take-profit) = 2 × (1 − Φ( ln(1 + TP) ÷ (σ × √hold) )) × the dials' hit multipliers — the chance a random walk touches the target
P(dies) = death share per 24 h × hold ÷ 24

drift at max hold = fair-bet drift + edge. The fair-bet drift, (P(dies) × loss − P(hit) × TP) ÷ P(neither), is what the other trades must average for the whole trade to break even before costs. That part cancels, so the take-profit and the hold move the result only through how many trades carry the edge (and, for the hold, the guessed k) — they cannot create money on their own.
edge = edge at 24 h × (hold ÷ 24)^k, backed out from the reference measurement
so it all reduces to: P(neither) × edge − round-trip costs + the dials' shifts (measured where a test measured them, guessed elsewhere)
vs the random twin: the same formula run with the twin's own inputs, minus
strategies.twin_desc: a random coin from the same eligible set at the same moment, same exits and costs (matched twin)

Two definitions share these levels — check each point's test name: 10-02 “market regime × every dial” = the all-coins guarded basket (Falling / Flat / Rising = bottom / middle / top third of a pre-pass, P2 ≤ −0.21% / ≥ −0.02%, P1 ≤ −0.15% / ≥ −0.01% per hour); 09-27 “new dials” = the labelled-coins basket, falling / rising only, its own cut-offs

vars.name: Wash trading (24 h)
vars.setting: (not on the setup page yet) all. Levels are the bottom / top third of a pre-pass with no results in it, set separately for the held point and for busy coins. Data: PARTIAL

vars.name: Snipers still holding
vars.setting: Unknown (not measured yet). To be measured from the swap tape: wallets that bought in a coin's first minutes, minus what they have sold since
vars.limit_note: not measured yet — only Unknown can be chosen

vars.name: Time of day (UTC)
vars.setting: (not on the setup page yet) all. Levels are the bottom / top third of a pre-pass with no results in it, set separately for the held point and for busy coins

vars.name: Main pool quote
vars.setting: (not on the setup page yet) which token the coin's main pool is priced in; WETH only skips USDG- and stock-token-quoted pools

vars.name: Capital cap
vars.setting: (not on the setup page yet) the most coins held at once; a signal is skipped when the cap is full

sigma.name: Price swing σ (per √hour)
sigma.note: backed out with the touch formula from the measured hit share 44.6% (+30% within 24 h; trading-history test, all coins, unseen days, n 2,069)

sigma_t.name: Twin: price swing σ
sigma_t.note: backed out from the twins' measured hit share 12.1%

die.name: Share of trades whose pool dies, per 24 h
die.note: measured: 10 of 2,069 trades exited on a drained pool (trading-history test, all coins, unseen days)

die_t.name: Twin: share whose pool dies, per 24 h
die_t.note: measured: 5 of 5,234 twin trades exited on a drained pool

loss.name: Loss on death
loss.note: measured: mean result of the drained exits, -96.4%

loss_t.name: Twin: loss on death
loss_t.note: measured on the twins' drained exits

edge.name: Edge at 24 h (per trade that neither hit nor died)
edge.note: backed out from the trading-history test's all-coins cell (-0.61%/trade, dip on the merged series), moved to a main-pool dip by the stress test's measured +1.70 — so the formula reproduces that cell exactly

edge_t.name: Twin: edge at 24 h
edge_t.note: backed out from the twins' -4.20%/trade at the same cell

cost.name: Round-trip costs
cost.note: the tests' cost rules: 1% pool fee each way + 0.4% slippage each way + 0.2 gas (V4 fills were priced from pool depth, so this is an approximation)

k.name: How the edge grows with hold (exponent k)
k.note: edge at hold H = edge at 24 h × (H/24)^k. k = 0.5 is a random-walk guess; nobody has measured it

cost_real.name: Round-trip costs, REAL (measured per pool)
cost_real.note: measured: a $50 round trip on the typical Blood entry pool, fee terms read on chain and matched to 144 of 145 real swaps (CI 5.35–6.03; R-0111). Used when the page's costs are set to real

cost_heavy.name: Round-trip costs, old HEAVY view
cost_heavy.note: the retired heavy view (1.4% a side + 1% on hook pools, R-0111) — used only to compare the formula with points measured that way

strategies.name: 📣 Callers
strategies.lede: Buy the coins that Telegram callers post.
strategies.formula_text: expected return per trade = P(hit take-profit) × take-profit + P(miss) × drift at the end of the hold − round-trip costs
formula_parts: P(hit take-profit) = 2 × (1 − Φ( ln(1 + TP) ÷ (σ × √hold) )) × the dials' hit multipliers — the chance a random walk touches the target

drift at the end of the hold = fair-bet drift + edge. The fair-bet drift, −P(hit) × TP ÷ P(miss), makes the trade break even before costs; that part cancels, so the take-profit and the hold move the result only through how many trades carry the edge (and the guessed k).
edge = edge at 1 h × hold^k, backed out from the reference measurement
so it all reduces to: P(miss) × edge − round-trip costs + the dials' shifts (measured where the test measured them)
vs the random coins: the same formula with the random coins' inputs, minus
strategies.twin_desc: 3 random coins of the same age and activity, bought at the same moment, same exits and costs

strategies.name: 💧 LP
strategies.lede: Provide liquidity to a pool and earn its trading fees.
strategies.formula_text: expected return per position = fees + price drift − impermanent loss − round-trip costs
formula_parts: fees = fees per 6 h × the dials' fee multipliers × (hold ÷ 6 h)^fee exponent
price drift = (drift per 6 h + the dials' shifts) × (hold ÷ 6 h)^k
impermanent loss = IL per 6 h × the dials' IL multipliers × (hold ÷ 6 h)^k
vs random: the same formula with the pool pick set to a random eligible pool, minus
strategies.twin_desc: 10 random pools from the same eligible set at the same time

strategies.name: 🛒 Spot buy & hold
strategies.lede: Buy and hold for a set time.
strategies.formula_text: expected return per trade = price move over the hold + entry-signal lift − round-trip costs
formula_parts: price move over the hold = price move over 6 h × (hold ÷ 6 h)^k
entry-signal lift = measured difference between signals (random picks vs profile picks)
vs random: the same formula with the entry signal set to a random pick, minus
strategies.twin_desc: a random eligible coin at the same hour, same hold and costs

lift: measured: random picks minus profile picks at 6 h

vars.name: Run-up in the hour before entry
Hold time
vars.limit_note: a hold must be longer than 0

g6.name: Price move over 6 h, before costs
g6.note: backed out so the formula reproduces the measured -1.88% per trade at 6 h — error 0 there by construction

cost.name: Round-trip costs
cost.note: the study's cost per trade with the app-fee piece removed (pool fee both ways + fill premium)

k.name: How the price move grows with hold (exponent k)
